name: pi-outpost-plannings
description: Build and change project plannings in the conversation, kept as files in a folder you choose, and shown as an interactive timeline.
long_description: Ask for a planning — tasks, activities, milestones, dependencies — and it is drawn as an interactive timeline in the conversation. Each planning is one readable file in the folder you choose, with every earlier version kept in a hidden history beside it. Click a task or a milestone, then ask to change "it". No account, no network: everything stays on this computer.

plannings_dir.title: Plannings folder
plannings_dir.description: Choose or create a folder for your plannings

tools.name: create_planning
tools.description: Creates a planning in your folder.

tools.name: get_planning
tools.description: Reads a planning, and what you selected in it.

tools.name: update_planning
tools.description: Changes a planning; every version is kept.

tools.name: show_planning
tools.description: Shows a planning as an interactive timeline, or what changed since an earlier version.
